status: TESLA SOP9 FUNCTIONS/COLORS VERIFIED; FINAL AMPLIFIER-SIDE LABEL PLAN DEFINED
evidence: Tesla SOP9 connector metadata in this repository defines the standard-audio MCU source channels, exact source cavities and wire colors on X171 and X175.
Tesla SOP9 speaker connector metadata in this repository defines the final speaker-side connector and polarity colors for the front woofers, three dashboard speakers and rear door speakers.
Car-Hifi Store Bunde confirmed that Front Left, Center and Front Right are the three instrument-panel speakers behind the windshield.

Owner-supplied photos show labelled IN +/-, OUT +/- conductors for Front Low Left, Front Low Right, Front Left, Center, Front Right, Rear Left and Rear Right, plus Optional Woofer 1 +/- and Optional Woofer 2 +/-.

directionSemantics.IN: Tesla OEM speaker-level source -> HELIX V TWELVE DSP MK2 HIGHLEVEL INPUT
directionSemantics.OUT: HELIX V TWELVE DSP MK2 amplified OUTPUT CHANNEL -> vehicle-side speaker return

labelingRule.summary: Do not rename the seven logical functions merely because the donor harness is the Ryzen version. Keep/reapply the speaker-function labels shown below, but route each pair to the verified SOP9 Tesla circuit and add the V TWELVE A-G channel identifier.
labelingRule.inputPolarity: On the V TWELVE HIGHLEVEL INPUT connector, each channel is printed -X +X. Connect sleeve IN - to -X and sleeve IN + to +X.
labelingRule.outputPolarity: On the V TWELVE OUTPUT CHANNELS connector, each channel is printed +X -X. Connect sleeve OUT + to +X and sleeve OUT - to -X.
labelingRule.critical: The old M141318 printed sleeve name is only trusted after that conductor pair has been traced/re-routed to the SOP9 circuit listed here. Tesla SOP9 circuit identity comes from Tesla data, not from the old sleeve.

optionalWooferLead.plannedUse: Optional Woofer 1 +/- becomes V TWELVE J -> SUB01; Optional Woofer 2 +/- becomes V TWELVE K -> SUB02. Each woofer is independent; no bridge, series or parallel connection is used.
optionalWooferLead.workingBasis: European TS-WX1220AH / TS-WX1210AH product data supports a 2-ohm working basis; verify each loose driver's DCR before first energization.

ryzenHarnessRework.scope: Trace the M141318 conductors by the verified SOP9 source and speaker-side wire colors above, then route them so each logical sleeve pair serves the matching SOP9 function. Do not rely on the old Ryzen cavity position alone.
ryzenHarnessRework.verificationBoundary: Tesla SOP9 functions, polarities and wire colors are verified. The remaining checks are that the modified physical M141318 conductors land on the intended circuits and that each loose Pioneer donor woofer is consistent with the 2-ohm European working basis before energization.
ryzenHarnessRework.finalQc: Continuity-check the completed modified harness and measure each loose Pioneer donor woofer DCR before plugging in or energizing the V TWELVE.
